label: MiDashengLM-Gen unified audio-scene generator
summary: Optional hosted or explicitly operated sidecar for short audio-scene sketches that combine speech, music, effects, and environment; it is not the EPRS groove or mastering engine.

handoffs.label: Generate a bounded audio-scene sketch
handoffs.intent: Explore one scene, hook, transition, or vocal/animal-response idea, then return it to EPRS as an unapproved source stem.
inputs: A structured prompt using caption, asr, speech, music, sfx, and env fields
A declared Space or sidecar endpoint, model revision, seed, and quota/auth state
A local EPRS fallback plan for unsupported hardware or unavailable remote compute
outputs: A new 16 kHz mono WAV sketch with the returned status and checksum
A provenance sidecar recording endpoint, model, prompt, settings, seed, and license evidence
A local mix handoff that preserves the sketch as a source stem rather than a finished song
steps: Check the official paper, model card, repository, license, endpoint health, and current quota before sending a prompt.
Use the smallest useful prompt and one bounded generation; do not retry quota failures in a loop.
Resample and mix locally only after preserving the original 16 kHz mono output and exact prompt.
Keep Sonic Pi or BeatScript responsible for groove, form, and player-facing timing; keep Shotcut responsible for local picture assembly.
verification: Confirm the returned file is non-empty, opens, has the declared sample rate/channels, and has a checksum.
Distinguish a real generated sketch from a local fallback or prompt-inspired arrangement in the manifest and public notes.
Do not publish until rights, privacy, quality, and any synthetic-media disclosure requirements are separately checked.

handoffs.label: Translate scene grammar into a local EPRS arrangement
handoffs.intent: Use MiDashengLM's structured scene vocabulary as an optional planning layer while retaining arbitrary EPRS tools, meters, genres, and human performances.
inputs: A scene brief with independent music, speech, sfx, and environment roles
Any available local beat, voice, animal, guitar, or visual sources
outputs: A local arrangement map and optional source-stem plan
A clear record of which tool actually rendered each layer
steps: Treat the special-token vocabulary as a compositional map, not a mandatory EPRS format.
Build the early identity, withheld pocket, lift, drop, hook, animal response, and turnaround with the best available local tools.
Keep weird beats and future tools welcome; never collapse the project around this model's prompt grammar.
verification: Record whether MiDashengLM actually rendered audio or only informed the local arrangement.
Preserve the local source chain, rights evidence, and final mastering authority.

preserve: The exact structured prompt, model revision, endpoint, seed, settings, returned WAV, checksum, and license evidence
The distinction between hosted model output, local EPRS composition, human performance, animal source audio, and final release
avoid: Claiming the model rendered when the Space quota or hardware blocked it, uploading private recordings without explicit clearance, or treating a short scene sketch as a finished song
Unbounded quota retries, hidden cloud processing, public personal/source identifiers, or replacing Sonic Pi, Shotcut, or future tools with one fixed model path
